talk.line01: Let’s do the release. We promised the client Friday.
talk.line02: Backend is ready, but Apple Pay hasn’t passed tests yet.
talk.line03: On my machine it fails on refunds — I sent the log yesterday.
talk.line04: Saw the log. That’s a bank timeout, not our code.
talk.line05: The client is asking whether the demo is still Tuesday.
talk.line06: Demo on Tuesday, if we close refunds by Monday.
talk.line07: Monday isn’t realistic, regression needs one more day.
talk.line08: I can ship without refunds, behind a flag.
talk.line09: Then we lock it: release Friday, refunds next sprint.
talk.line10: I’ll warn the client that refunds come later.
talk.line11: And somebody has to update the webhook docs.
talk.line12: James, will you take the docs?
talk.line13: I will, but not before Wednesday.
talk.line14: I’ll send the notes out today.

decision.label: Decision
decision.value: Refunds next sprint, behind a flag

note1.body: James promised the webhook docs from Wednesday. That’s tomorrow — remind him?

note2.body: Daniel meant to send the notes out today. They haven’t gone out.

note3.body: Olivia asked for an extra regression day, but the release is still Friday. Raise it at standup?

note4.body: The client still hasn’t heard that refunds are slipping. Remind Daniel?
